title: panisea zeylanica
intro: Panisea zeylanica, commonly known as the "Thailand slipper orchid", is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, where it is valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Panisea zeylanica include its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
